facts.label: O aquário
facts.sub: Os aquários americanos têm tanques gigantes com peixes, tartarugas e tubarões. As luzes azuis e a música suave criam um ambiente calmo.

facts.label: Tanque de toque
facts.sub: Em alguns tanques, você pode tocar em estrelas-do-mar com um dedo, com gentileza. Molhe as mãos antes e nunca puxe os animais.

pages.title: Blue light · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eleven in the morning at a big aquarium in Monterey. Blue light fills long dark halls. Huge tanks hold colorful fish and slow turtles. Dina walks in with her camera and a map. A guide in a navy shirt stands near a big tank. Her name tag says Marin.
“Welcome to the aquarium! Do you have any questions?” says Marin. “Yes. Can I touch the fish?” says Dina. “No, you can’t touch the fish in the big tanks.” says Marin.

pages.title: Blue light · 3/3
paragraphs: “I understand. And can I eat inside?” says Dina. “You can’t eat in the galleries. Please use the cafe.” says Marin. Dina touches a starfish with one finger. She turns off the flash and takes calm photos. She watches a shark glide above her head. At noon, she eats lunch in the cafe by the window. She leaves with a small stuffed turtle. Respect keeps wild homes safe.
